        title_part, artists_part = ln.split(' by ', 1)

        # fallback: split on 'by'

    title = title_part.strip()
    artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',') if a.strip()]
    entries.append({'raw': ln, 'title': title, 'artists': artists})

# ===== Spotify: add missing songs & download =====
import re

def norm_title(s):
    return re.sub(r'\s+',' ', (s or '').strip().lower())

def norm_artist(s):
    return re.sub(r'\s+',' ', (s or '').strip().lower())

def key_for(title, artists_list):
    # artists_list: list[str]
    return (norm_title(title), frozenset(norm_artist(a) for a in (artists_list or [])))

# Build existing mapping from playlist_detail songs
existing_song_list = playlist_detail.get('songs', [])
existing_key_to_song_id = {}
